say:2:1041566701:1.text: Come, Isabella, have a glass of warm milk.
say:2:1041566701:1.source_cn: 来，伊莎贝拉，先喝杯热牛奶。

say:3:1041566702:1.text: After I finished my mission, I found time to buy you this book.
say:3:1041566702:1.source_cn: 我这次任务顺便为你带了一本小册子。

say:4:1041566703:1.text: It's an adventure story written by a sailor.
say:4:1041566703:1.source_cn: 据说是水手写的冒险故事。

say:5:1041566704:1.text: Oh, is it a story about pirates? Like the ones from the Dead Tide Fleet?
say:5:1041566704:1.source_cn: 水手？像死潮舰队那样的海盗故事吗？

say:6:1041566705:1.text: Yeah, probably... Anyway, it's a story about someone with a ship.
say:6:1041566705:1.source_cn: 类似吧……大概，总之是有人开船的故事。

say:7:1041566706:1.source_cn: 姐姐对书本的评论太简洁啦。

say:8:1041566707:1.text: Well, I want to hear about the mission you just finished. Did you get to travel on a ship? Oh, did you get to see any pirates and mermaids?
say:8:1041566707:1.source_cn: 说起来，姐姐这次任务也是坐船往返吗？有见到海盗和美人鱼吗？

say:9:1041566708:1.text: Yes, I was on a ship and saw some pirates and mermaids, well… I'm not sure if they count as mermaids.
say:9:1041566708:1.source_cn: 坐船，见到了海盗，但人鱼……我不确定那算不算是。

say:10:1041566709:1.text: I mainly just dealt with some humans.
say:10:1041566709:1.source_cn: 主要还是与人类打交道。

say:11:1041566710:1.text: Let me get you something to eat. You can start reading.
say:11:1041566710:1.source_cn: 我去给你拿些点心，你在这里慢慢看书吧。

say:12:1041566711:1.text: Every time I ask her about her mission, she changes the subject...
say:12:1041566711:1.source_cn: 每次一问姐姐任务，她就岔开话题……

say:13:1041566712:1.text: I wonder when I can start going out on missions with her...
say:13:1041566712:1.source_cn: 不知道什么时候才能帮得上姐姐的忙……
